sources.entry: BigBlueButton - Supports real-time sharing of audio, video, slides (with whiteboard controls), chat, and the screen. Instructors can engage remote students with polling, emojis, and breakout rooms. (Source Code) LGPL-3.0 Java

summary.one_liner: BigBlueButton is an open-source virtual classroom for online teaching and learning, supporting real-time audio, video, slides, chat, screen sharing, polling, and breakout rooms.
summary.what_it_does: BigBlueButton supports real-time sharing of audio, video, slides with whiteboard annotations, chat, and the screen. Instructors can engage remote learners with polling, emojis, multi-user whiteboards, shared notes, and breakout rooms. During sessions it generates analytics visible to moderators in a Learning Analytics Dashboard. Presenters can record and play back sessions for later sharing. The README names online tutoring, flipped classrooms, group collaboration, and online classes as its educational use cases, and notes it can serve other applications too.
use_cases: Running online classes for many students
how_to_run: Install on Ubuntu 24.04 using bbb-install.sh (per the README, the install is intended to take about 30 minutes)
notable: Built-in polling, emoji reactions, multi-user whiteboard, and shared notes for engaging remote students
Learning Analytics Dashboard for moderators during sessions
GreenLight named as the default front-end
caveats: Install script targets Ubuntu 24.04 per the README; other platforms are not described
Full technical documentation is referenced externally rather than in the README
